package rulefixtures

import (
	"bytes"
	"encoding/json"
)

// scenario for json_indent_in_loop: `json.Indent(...)` inside loops.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: performance; severity: info.
type Record struct {
	Name  string `json:"name"`
	Count int    `json:"count"`
}

func formatRecords(records []Record) ([]string, error) {
	var out []string
	for _, r := range records {
		data, err := json.Marshal(r)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		var buf bytes.Buffer
		if err := json.Indent(&buf, data, "", "  "); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		out = append(out, buf.String())
	}
	return out, nil
}
